truth: Both locks declare the same Thread 1 VERCEL_UNIVERSAL_INTAKE scope. They must be treated as one logical ownership domain, not two workers/shards.
requiredAction: Do not start a second independent Thread 1 intake. Existing Thread 1 workers must coordinate against the same durable intake/checkpoints and skip records already owned or preserved.
prohibitedActions: Do not delete either lock during emergency recovery.
Do not count duplicate lock ownership as additional recovery capacity.
Do not ingest the same projectId:deploymentId twice.
